tools.name: query_jurisdiction
tools.description: Read-only. Returns the published record for one of the 56 U.S. jurisdictions (states, DC, territories) from the site's Care vs. Code ledger: brain-injury waivers, requests sent, funding rates, claims-system and program-integrity holders, each with its source URL and VERIFIED / NOT FOUND ONLINE / NOT

tools.name: verify_archive_sha256
tools.description: Read-only. Looks a SHA-256 (64 hex characters) up in the site's published manifest (/for-ai/manifest.json). A match means the file is listed in the manifest; no match does not prove a file is not authentic.

tools.name: trace_proof_chain
tools.description: Read-only. Searches the published proof-chain dataset (what was reported, received and done, office by office) by office name, record id (for example pc-24a5451606ab) or agency control number. Returns at most 20 rows. A receipt is not an investigation.

tools.name: get_federal_authorities
tools.description: Read-only static list of federal citations with official .gov URLs, each labeled VERIFIED (text opened on the official source), plus one entry labeled as an untested legal question. No arguments.
